already_frozen: same microglia contact pairs evaluated against microglia, neuron and oligodendrocyte accessibility
microglia must exceed both same-study cell-type comparators
microglia observed support must exceed shuffled null
same-study concordance is internal substrate compatibility, not independent corroboration

source_support.paper: Nott et al. 2019 reports that cell-type-enriched PLAC-seq interactions colocalize with increased cell-type-specific ATAC-seq, H3K27ac and H3K4me3 signal, so testing contact/accessibility compatibility is source-consistent rather than invented for this project.

still_requires_prospective_operational_f.binary_accessibility_support_rule: UNSPECIFIED: e.g. any-base interval overlap versus center inclusion versus fractional overlap. Must be frozen before support counts are inspected.
still_requires_prospective_operational_f.shuffle_algorithm: UNSPECIFIED beyond promoter fixed, chromosome/distance distribution preserved and degree preserved where feasible.
still_requires_prospective_operational_f.shuffle_precision_authority: UNSPECIFIED: number of randomisations/seeds must not be chosen after seeing null variability. Prior project history explicitly rejects inheriting arbitrary 999/1000-style replicate counts without a precision rule.
still_requires_prospective_operational_f.paired_contrast_and_uncertainty_estimato: UNSPECIFIED in the short authoritative P1S contract.
still_requires_prospective_operational_f.nuisance_adjustment_implementation: UNSPECIFIED: the listed nuisance variables do not themselves define an estimator. Do not silently import the later RNA/ATAC continuous-adjustment estimator.

already_frozen_logic: target gene is expressed in microglia
distal element is accessible in microglia
relationship itself is absent from the microglia contact map
trivial negatives are excluded and attrition reported

source_audit.finding: Nott Table S5/interactome is not itself an expression authority. Public third-party workflows combining the Nott interactome with expression import a separate expression dataset.

P3.hard_rule: Do not substitute active-promoter chromatin marks for measured gene expression merely to satisfy the expression condition unless a successor contract explicitly redefines the condition prospectively.
